summary: Iteration 12 — 2-tier role system (super_admin/office_admin) tested end-to-end on backend AND frontend. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (test_iteration12.py). Frontend: All 7 acceptance flows verified on https://finance-flow-1727.preview.emergentagent.com. Register flow shows the auth-pending-screen with 'Awaiting approval' message and does NOT auto-login (cookie not set). Login as office_admin (blr1@finflow.com) shows EXACTLY the expected 7 nav items (nav-overview, nav-quick-entry, nav-transactions, nav-clients, nav-students, nav-office-expenses, nav-settings) and correctly HIDES nav-accounts/nav-invoices/nav-ledger/nav-users/nav-categories/nav-approvals. Office Admin /expense-requests page: 'New request' dialog opens, submit creates a pending request and shows it as a req-card-<id> with 'pending' badge and KM_BLR office tag. Office Admin /clients page shows title 'Our Staff', add-client-btn label is 'Add staff', list only shows staff entries (TEST_IT12_StaffPerson + Ravi Kumar) with eligible_incentive/date_of_birth visible. Super_admin login shows all 12 expected nav items. /users page renders Pending/Approved/Rejected/All tabs, lists the pending office-admin (Test Office Admin · KM_TCR) with Approve/Reject buttons. /expense-requests (Approvals) shows the cross-office request with requester name + KM_BLR office; clicking Approve opens a dialog with account select; submitting approval creates a real expense transaction on the requester's books (verified via API — linked_transaction_id present, type=expense, amount matches, linked_expense_request_id set). Student dialog has 'Reference (staff)' dropdown. accounts ?for_user_id=X returns target user's accounts with current_balance for super_admin and 403 for office_admin. Staff client creation accepts office/eligible_incentive/date_of_birth and returns them in the doc. Reject flow flips status to rejected with decision_note. Office admin can cancel own pending but not approved (400). Super admin cannot change own approval status (400). Pending user login blocked (403). All 17 acceptance criteria from review_request pass.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on initial render — cosmetic; chart renders correctly after layout settles. Per agent-to-agent context, the office_admin dashboard is Phase-2 work and not a defect.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.py register flow correctly does NOT set the auth cookie and returns {ok, approval_status:'pending', message} — matches spec. Email lowercased & duplicate-checked. seed_user_defaults is invoked at registration so the user has accounts ready once approved.
users.py guards all 3 mutating endpoints with _require_super_admin and additionally prevents self-status-change and super-deleting-super. PATCH returns the fresh user doc (with _id stripped). Clean.

expense_requests.py approve flow is atomic-ish: validates account ownership, creates the transaction, then patches the request with linked_transaction_id. Note: not wrapped in a transaction — if the second update fails, the tx will exist without a linked request. Acceptable for current scale but worth flagging.
expense_requests.py GET enriches super_admin view with requested_by_name/email/office in a single $in query — efficient.

accounts.py ?for_user_id correctly forbids office_admin from peeking at another user's accounts (only super_admin allowed). current_balance is computed per-call via aggregation; for large transaction volumes consider a cached projection.
models.py ClientIn carries optional office/eligible_incentive/date_of_birth — backward compatible for non-staff client types.
Frontend Clients.jsx correctly hides the type filter and locks cli-type to 'staff' for isOfficeAdmin, with add-client-btn label flipping to 'Add staff' — verified visually.
AppShell role-filtered nav works perfectly; office_admin sees exactly 7 nav items, super_admin sees 12. Each item is identifiable by stable data-testid.

RegisterIn validates office at the Pydantic layer (Optional[OfficeCode]) — but the actual 'required' check is in the route handler. Could be tightened by making office mandatory at the model level for office_admin signups, though the current approach allows future role-aware variants.

Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration12.py -v. Frontend testids introduced this iteration: auth-pending-screen (register), nav-office-expenses, nav-users, nav-approvals, req-card-<id>. The Office dropdown on /register is a NATIVE <select> (not shadcn) — use page.select_option('select', 'KM_TCR').
